item.name: Beach House Paradise
item.cardSummary: A mostly outdoor resort map with a central fountain, hotel, shops, and art gallery, built from Beach House Roleplay geometry.
item.survivorNotes: Loops are scarce on the open layout. The hotel interior-to-exterior route and fountain rails are the main chase tools.
item.killerNotes: Open sightlines help tracking. Reset chase pressure if survivors hug fountain rails, and watch hotel loops closely.

item.name: Brandon6875935's Place
item.cardSummary: A large open outdoor map with maze-like wooden walls, a castle end, central stone structure, and under-construction Brandon World.
item.keyAreas: Castle, Cave Slope, White CTF corners, Brandon World
item.survivorNotes: Use castle and cave-slope height drops to create distance, then break line of sight on wooden wall loops. Avoid lingering in open ground while repairing.
item.killerNotes: Survivors often cluster near the castle and cave slope. Cut off open generators and save stamina for long intercept sprints across the large footprint.

item.name: Glass Houses
item.cardSummary: A lightly forested outdoor map with two glass-topped mountains linked by a red glass bridge, plus scattered walls and an L-shaped concrete structure.
item.keyAreas: Jail Mountain, Glass House, Big Mountain, Small Mountain
item.survivorNotes: Stay near mountains, the L-shaped concrete structure, and red glass bridge pillars to break sightlines. Keep moving between solid cover.
item.killerNotes: Open terrain favors traps and slowdown tools. Mind map edges and force survivors off strong structure loops.

item.name: Natural Disaster Island
item.cardSummary: An outdoor island that combines Natural Disaster Survival landmarks into one abandoned stage with meteor debris and industrial buildings.
item.survivorNotes: Use building interiors and construction cover to break long outdoor sightlines while rotating generators across the island.
item.killerNotes: Patrol petrol station, supermarket, and factory routes. Force survivors out of building pockets into open ground between landmarks.

item.name: Planet Voss
item.cardSummary: A mostly flat outdoor map with a center crater, colored fortresses and spaceships, and scattered walls for short loops.
item.keyAreas: Center Crater, Mini Fortresses, Colored Spaceships
item.survivorNotes: Loop around fortresses, spaceships, and crater walls. Use small elevation changes to create distance when the killer commits.
item.killerNotes: Open sightlines make spotting easier. Camp key generator pockets around the fortresses and crater rather than over-chasing across the flat ground.

item.name: The Tempest
item.cardSummary: A very open Noli-themed map defined by temples, a center statue, towers, and scattered pillars and walls.
item.keyAreas: Black temple, Big Temple, Center Statue, Large Tower, Smaller Temple
item.survivorNotes: Use pillars, walls, and temple interiors to break line of sight. Take elevation when available instead of repairing all generators in one push.
item.killerNotes: Survivors are easier to spot in the open. Block temple entrances and pressure the center statue routes to cut map rotations.

item.name: Bloodfell Manor
item.cardSummary: A Victorian-style manor and yard themed as Nosferatu’s lair, with library, kitchen, living spaces, and statue-filled grounds.
item.keyAreas: Manor, Yard, Library, Stairs, Kitchen, Living room, Piano
item.survivorNotes: Use multi-room indoor paths and the yard statue area to break chase lines. Avoid getting pinned on stair choke points.
item.killerNotes: Indoor corridors and stair access favor cutoffs. Check library and living-room loops when survivors leave the yard.

item.name: Familiar Ruins
item.cardSummary: Flood Escape 2 collab ruins with a multiplayer main building, hill ramp, lava lake edge, and broken lobby structures.
item.hazards: Lava cracks and fire apply Burning I for 4s
item.keyAreas: Main Building (Multiplayer), Hill, Lava lake, Black structure
item.survivorNotes: Use the multi-entrance main building and hill drop-offs for chase control. Avoid lava cracks while looping.
item.killerNotes: Pressure the main building doors and hill ramp entrance. Hazards punish careless survivor paths around lava gaps.

item.name: Horror Hotel
item.cardSummary: A compact hotel layout mixing an outdoor field with indoor halls, kitchen, play area, well, and many small rooms.
item.hazards: Field hands apply short Slowness effects
item.keyAreas: Outdoor Field, Halls, Play Area, Kitchen, Well, Small Rooms
item.survivorNotes: Indoor rooms and the play area create strong evasion options. Repair with teammates and learn hall connections for long survival.
item.killerNotes: Ranged pressure and checking the play area help clear hides. Punish solo survivors moving between halls and the outdoor field.

item.name: Pirate Bay
item.cardSummary: A stormy mixed map of shore structures, rock stands, a two-story house, and boat landmarks with limited generator spawn spots.
item.keyAreas: Center Structure, Rock Stand, Two-Story House, Boat
item.survivorNotes: Loop structures and elevated stands rather than hard-hiding. Use building geometry to reset chase angles.
item.killerNotes: Push survivors into water puddles for Bleeding pressure and place traps on common structure loops.

item.name: Ultimate Assassin Grounds
item.cardSummary: A mixed dojo-and-lake arena with caves, houses, a gate, and obstacle routes above water that slow movement.
item.hazards: Lake and waterfall water apply Slowness II
item.keyAreas: Cave, Big dojo, Run-down dojo, Target practice area, Lake, Obstacle course above water, Connected brown houses, Gate
item.survivorNotes: Strong loops include the cave and gate areas. Lure chases through slow water when you can cross safely and use elevation to avoid some attacks.
item.killerNotes: Cut off house and lake routes with abilities that block escapes. Elevated spots are often not high enough to fully avoid pressure.

item.name: Work at a Pizza Place
item.cardSummary: A ruined Main Island take on Work at a Pizza Place with Builder Brothers' Pizza, dump, housing, and supplier areas under a dark red sky.
item.keyAreas: Builder Brothers' Pizza, The Dump, Two Story House, Supplier Area
item.survivorNotes: Loop the dining and counter areas, including broken-wall paths. Avoid isolation because evasion is the main defense.
item.killerNotes: Do not let survivors settle in the supply room loops. Trap common pizza-building routes and force open-ground rotations.

item.name: Yorick's Resting Place
item.cardSummary: A dark forest and cliff map with Yorick’s house, a graveyard, temple ridge, and purple acid rivers that damage both sides.
item.hazards: Acid rivers apply Poisoned or Corrupted and Slowness effects
item.keyAreas: Yorick's house, Graveyard, Cliff with temple, Acid rivers
item.survivorNotes: The large footprint helps evasion if you avoid open ground and acid rivers. Cross on bridges and work as a team on generators.
item.killerNotes: Use river crossings as risky shortcuts, force cliff mistakes, and favor tools that punish long forest pathing.

item.name: C00l Carnival
item.cardSummary: A dense carnival map with packed attractions, an exhibit, entrance, and Ferris Wheel, themed around c00lkidd’s takeover of a party layout.
item.survivorNotes: Terror radius is frequent because the map is small and dense. Stick near teammates and use Ferris Wheel and van-side loops to reset chases.
item.killerNotes: Tight geometry favors cornering. Force survivors off the Ferris Wheel and pizza-van loops with unpredictable pathing.

item.name: Cake Factory
item.cardSummary: A mostly indoor factory map with cramped floors, incineration rooms, management lounge, and Giant Noob area based on Make a Cake.
item.keyAreas: Plaza and Garage, Incineration Room, Main Factory Floor, Management and The Lounge, The Giant Noob Area
item.survivorNotes: Loop incineration rooms, shaping-station cover, and management or lounge paths. Use Gertrude’s Shelf near the rising station to break line of sight.
item.killerNotes: Cramped indoor routes help trapping. Cut off factory-floor loops and deny safe repair pockets in incineration and lounge areas.

item.name: Classic Battlegrounds
item.cardSummary: A small two-segment map with elevated buildings, street tunnels, sewers, temple grounds, waterfall, and a golden-hammer statue.
item.keyAreas: Cave, Sewer grates, Library, Temple, Empty store, Sewers, Golden hammer statue, Waterfall
item.survivorNotes: Use elevation and tight structure paths to create distance. Expect frequent terror-radius pressure in the compact layout.
item.killerNotes: Trap cramped cave, sewer, and store routes. Clear sewer grates and cave pockets when survivors disappear.

item.name: Underground War
item.cardSummary: A two-layer fortress map with open red and blue surface halves plus a semi-enclosed underground level and killer-only lower entrances.
item.hazards: Vertical layers can hide audio cues between floors
item.keyAreas: Surface, Underground, Red Half, Blue Half
item.survivorNotes: You may not hear a killer on the other floor, so check vertical pressure constantly. Avoid underground dead ends and use entrance loops to create distance.
item.killerNotes: The lower layer is strong for trapping, and killer-only underground entrances can catch survivors off-guard. Abuse vertical audio separation while rotating floors.
